builder-potion.name: Builder Potion
builder-potion.description: Brewed by the Builder in case of emergency all-nighters, this invigorating potion allows your builders to work 10x faster for 1h. Works in Home Village!

research-potion.name: Research Potion
research-potion.description: This healthy-looking beverage helps the mysterious Wizards inside the Laboratory research 24x faster for 1h. Works in Home Village!

pet-potion.name: Pet Potion
pet-potion.description: Containing everything a Pet needs for a healthy, glossy coat. This helps Pets upgrade 24x faster for 1h.

book-of-heroes.name: Book of Heroes
book-of-heroes.description: Full of heroic tales and sound advice, this magical book can be used to instantly complete any ongoing hero or pet upgrade timer. Works in both villages!

book-of-building.name: Book of Building
book-of-building.description: Supposedly authored by the Master Builder himself, this magical book can be used to instantly complete any building upgrade. Works in both villages!

book-of-fighting.name: Book of Fighting
book-of-fighting.description: Filled with very efficient training programs, this magical book can be used to instantly complete any ongoing troop upgrade. Works in both villages!

book-of-spells.name: Book of Spells
book-of-spells.description: Written by unknown wizards, this magical book can be used to instantly complete any ongoing spell upgrade. Works in Home Village.

book-of-everything.name: Book of Everything
book-of-everything.description: This extremely powerful magical encyclopedia can be used to instantly complete any ongoing upgrade. Works in both villages!

hammer-of-heroes.name: Hammer of Heroes
hammer-of-heroes.description: A swing of this magic hammer will instantly upgrade any hero or pet to the next level. Works in both villages!

hammer-of-building.name: Hammer of Building
hammer-of-building.description: A swing of this magic hammer will instantly upgrade any building to the next level. Works in both villages!

hammer-of-fighting.name: Hammer of Fighting
hammer-of-fighting.description: A swing of this magic hammer will instantly upgrade any troop to the next level. Works in both villages!

hammer-of-spells.name: Hammer of Spells
hammer-of-spells.description: A swing of this magic hammer will instantly upgrade any spell to the next level. Works in the Home Village!
